description_en: Queries the associations between a multicast domain and vSwitches
description_zh: 您可以调用ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainAssociations接口查询组播域和交换机的关联关系
kebab_example: aliyun cbn list-transit-router-multicast-domain-associations --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-42660000 --transit-router-multicast-domain-id tr-mcast-domain-91wpg6wbhchjeq0000 --transit-router-attachment-id tr-attach-p90y3ymbbwuvy50000 --vswitchids vsw-p0w9s2ig1jnwgrbzl0000 --resource-type VPC --resource-id vpc-p0w9alkte4w2htrqe0000 --max-results 20 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainAssociations

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of resource associated with the multicast domain.

Set the value to VPC
parameters.help_zh:
组播域关联的资源类型。

仅取值：VPC
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource associated with the multicast domain
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token that determines the start point of the query. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no subsequent query is to be sent, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If a subsequent query is to be sent, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token that determines the start point of the query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query is to be sent.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

Associated: associated.
